title: AI Agent Anti-Stock Locking: Eliminate Ghost Carts From Your E-commerce
body:
Did you know that your competitors could be draining your visible inventory without buying absolutely anything?

Malicious stock locking through ghost carts is one of the most destructive tactics in modern e-commerce. Automated bots enter your online store, add your star products to the cart, and keep sessions active for hours. For your system, the real stock is reserved; for your true customers, the product appears as sold out. The result is devastating: wasted ad spend, frustrated users who leave for the competition, and a drastic drop in your B2C revenue.

The Trap of Standard Anti-Bot Plugins

Traditional solutions rely on blocking IP addresses or using obsolete captchas that ruin the user experience (CRO) and reduce conversion. Modern bots mimic human clicks, use dynamic residential proxies, and bypass these barriers effortlessly. Protecting your inventory with fixed rules in a dynamic environment is losing the battle before it even begins.

Our Solution: AI Agent for Behavioral Analysis and Inventory Release

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we have designed an advanced artificial intelligence agent that integrates directly into your payment gateway and cloud storage system to monitor the semantic behavior of each cart in real time.

  1. Non-human pattern detection: The agent analyzes navigation speed, cursor movement, and the real purchase intent of the session.
  2. Predictive reservation management: It identifies anomalies in repetitive carts with multiple open tabs from suspicious networks.
  3. Atomic stock release: It instantly cancels the virtual reservation in your database if a malicious locking pattern is detected, keeping the product available for real buyers.
  4. Frictionless production integration: It runs on the backend via asynchronous architecture without adding a single millisecond of latency to your B2C or B2B user experience.

The Real Impact on Your Sales and Conversion

  • Blindshielded real availability: Ensures that your high-demand products are always accessible to authentic customers, maximizing the ROI of your organic and paid campaigns.
  • Elimination of competitive fraud: Completely neutralizes sabotage campaigns aimed at suffocating your highest revenue days like Black Friday.
  • Absolute automation: Forget about auditing logs by hand or manually clearing inventory; the AI agent acts autonomously 24 hours a day.
